phase: Source-domain deletion correction ensemble with sign-consensus attenuation
mechanism: Fit one correction member excluding each source domain. Compute mean r and mean absolute member correction a; multiply mean r by abs(r)/a, zero if a<=1e-12. Identical-sign members retain full ensemble mean. Mixed signs attenuate it. No reliability target or fitted gate.
selection: B123 original validation domain-equal MAE chooses feature/learner/alpha/gain shared across all8 parents. Ties smaller gain then key. All21 choices frozen before outer scoring.
control: Full-source balanced constant residual. If candidate passes, also compare ungated same-member ensemble and same-config full-source residual; no mechanism claim without these controls.
acceptance: Original three-dataset three-metric independent and incremental requirements, full16-group complementarity, paired intervals and risk stability unchanged.
limits: Source-domain deletion concerns residual fitting only; inherited parent OOF training is not additionally nested for each deletion
No correction in-sample errors used as reliability labels; there are no reliability labels
Consensus can be confidently wrong and is not calibrated uncertainty
Previously exposed development cohorts, not independent confirmation
No CALCE tuning; no new source labels; original models unchanged
Ensembling and sign-consensus attenuation are not claimed novel primitives
